source: FlyWire connectome v783 connectivity table (Shiu et al. brain model)

selection.method: top neurons by total synapse count (in+out), largest strongly connected component of the induced subgraph
selection.edge_weight: signed synapse count: 'Excitatory x Connectivity' of the raw table

The FlyWire data are subject to the FlyWire/Codex terms of use (flywire.ai); cite these papers when reusing the subgraph.
